__schema.description: koine-desktop/1. Descriptions expose authority requirements; discovery never grants authority.

types.name: Boolean
types.description: The `Boolean` scalar type represents `true` or `false`.

types.name: DesktopApplication
types.description: All fields require desktop:read.

types.name: DesktopFocusReceipt
types.description: Control-authorized output; it does not expose read-protected window state.

fields.name: ref
fields.description: The submitted target, under the mutation's control authority.

types.name: DesktopProcessStart
types.description: UTC instant with exactly six fractional second digits, captured from the process start time.

types.name: DesktopWindow
types.description: All fields require desktop:read.

types.name: ID
types.description: The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

types.name: Int
types.description: The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

fields.name: availableCapabilities
fields.description: Names available to request. Listing them supplies no authority.

fields.name: ownGrant
fields.description: Caller only; null only for the non-exportable in-process console principal.

fields.name: schemaDigest
fields.description: Equality token for the served schema; compare, do not interpret.

fields.name: capability
fields.description: The capability name, as listed in availableCapabilities and held by grants.

fields.name: disclosure
fields.description: Plain text stating the capability's reach, including any other capability it needs.

fields.name: credential
fields.description: One-time 32-byte random bearer secret encoded as unpadded base64url.

fields.name: grant
fields.description: Present only after approval; scoped to this request.

types.name: KoineManagement
types.description: All fields require koine:manage.

fields.name: capabilityDisclosures
fields.description: What a person must be told about each capability's reach wherever it is granted or reviewed, one entry per capability that has a disclosure and whether or not its provider is active. Show it beside the capability in grant creation, request approval and the grant list. Serving it supplies no authority.

fields.name: osPermissions
fields.description: Read on each request. Reading never asks the user for consent.

fields.name: candidateId
fields.description: Opaque identity of origin plus canonical installed bundle location, unique within this startup. Null only for a synthetic row. Not a resource reference.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Where the bundle is physically installed. Null for a synthetic row; never inferred from composition position.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Stable, open diagnostic code for a refusal or selection explanation. Null for a healthy selected row with nothing competing or missing.

fields.name: selectedCandidateId
fields.description: The frozen choice for the same provider identity, or null if there is none. A selected row points to itself, even after a later failure.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: Whether this candidate is the frozen choice for its provider identity. Synthetic rows are UNAVAILABLE.

inputFields.name: credentialDigest
inputFields.description: Canonical lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of a 32-byte random bearer secret.

fields.name: desktopFocusWindow
fields.description: desktop:control. Focuses exactly this window or reports why it did not; never a substitute.

fields.name: koineApproveGrantRequest
fields.description: koine:manage. Approves only a subset of the immutable requested capabilities.

fields.name: koineCreateGrant
fields.description: koine:manage. Credential is returned once after durable creation.

fields.name: koineDenyGrantRequest
fields.description: koine:manage. Denies a pending request.

fields.name: koineRequestGrant
fields.description: Anonymous enrollment only; cannot be mixed with other root actions.

fields.name: koineRevokeGrant
fields.description: koine:manage. Idempotent for an already revoked grant; never grants authority.

fields.name: workspaceLaunchApplication
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Launch or request reactivation of any registered installed app, not only configured shortcuts. Do not force a new instance; reuse a running copy unless applicationPath constrains the installation. Native acknowledgment is not a window-focus guarantee. Missing app is typed dependency absence; acknowledgment wait ends after three seconds or earlier cancellation, possibly after effects begin, with failed and no replay. The core request deadline may answer first. Koine resolves applicationPath and every registered copy it compares component by component, and copies compare by the device and inode that resolution finds. APPLICATION_NOT_INSTALLED keeps its meaning: no registration for the identifier, an applicationPath or unconstrained registered location that resolution finds missing, a present non-application, or a present constrained copy that is not registered; a whole-path ELOOP, ENAMETOOLONG or nil never establishes it, and a cycle or impossible name at an application location is failed. A constrained launch compares registered copies in order until one matches: one found missing or different is skipped; one whose resolution fails before the match is failed. A chosen or selected application location whose literal, link-expanded or resolved spelling is PATH_MAX (1,024) bytes or more, not counting its NUL, is failed before its metadata or any request: v1 does not hand such locations to applications. Link-budget exhaustion and unacquired native facts are failed. Established no-identifier remains mismatch for a named selector.

fields.name: workspaceOpenPath
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Open one literal absolute document/directory path in its default or named installed app. Refuse native application-bundle, Unix/Windows executable and Finder-alias metadata after symlink resolution; no content sandbox or race-free classification. Script/source documents can use default editors. A handler can execute scripts or follow location documents to other schemes/targets. No executable selector, argv, environment or shell expansion. Missing path/app/default handler is typed dependency absence; wait ends after three seconds or earlier cancellation, possibly after effects begin, with failed and no replay. The core deadline may answer first. Koine resolves the path first, then any applicationPath or discovered application, component by component. For the path, missing components, dangling links, established cycles and established impossible components are PATH_NOT_FOUND; an application location keeps APPLICATION_NOT_INSTALLED as for launch, and a stale default handler NO_DEFAULT_HANDLER. Link-budget exhaustion and other resolution errors are failed. An extant target, applicationPath or selected application whose literal, link-expanded or resolved spelling is PATH_MAX (1,024) bytes or more, not counting its NUL, is failed before any request: v1 does not hand such locations to applications. Each is refused at its own stage: a target before its metadata or handler lookup; an applicationPath before its metadata or registration lookup; a selected application (the matching registration, preferred copy or default handler) after the registration or handler lookup that found it, before its metadata. Below that limit, a nil default handler for a resolved target is NO_DEFAULT_HANDLER and a completed no-type report is not a refusal. Preserve target bytes and selected application identity.

fields.name: workspaceOpenURL
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Accept the ASCII RFC 3986 section 3 URI grammar, including optional query/fragment, with HTTP(S) scheme, host, valid percent escapes and no credentials/whitespace/backslashes/control characters; Unicode requires caller encoding and IDNA host labels. Preserve bytes without repair. Resolve by scheme alone and address that default browser explicitly; no universal-link app dispatch or suggestions proxy. The browser may act on the page. Missing handler is typed dependency absence; wait ends after three seconds or earlier cancellation, possibly after effects begin, with failed and no replay. The core deadline may answer first.

fields.name: workspaceRevealPath
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Reveal one literal absolute path in Finder without opening its contents. Native acknowledgment is not observed selection. Missing path/Finder is typed dependency absence; false acknowledgment or ambiguous failure is failed, never automatic replay. Wait ends after three seconds or earlier cancellation, ignoring late acknowledgment; the core deadline may answer first. Koine resolves the path component by component: missing components, dangling links, established cycles and established impossible components are PATH_NOT_FOUND; link-budget exhaustion and other resolution errors are failed. An extant location, or Finder's own, whose literal, link-expanded or resolved spelling is PATH_MAX (1,024) bytes or more, not counting its NUL, is failed before any Finder request. A link to the root, without a trailing slash, is selected as the link. Preserve submitted target bytes.

fields.name: desktopApplication
fields.description: desktop:read. An absent process is ordinary null.

fields.name: desktopApplicationByReference
fields.description: desktop:read. A stale or wrong-kind reference raises unavailable.

fields.name: desktopWindow
fields.description: desktop:read. A stale or wrong-kind reference raises unavailable.

fields.name: koine
fields.description: Authenticated caller metadata. No provider capability required.

fields.name: koineGrantRequest
fields.description: Proof of the submitted secret, or its resulting active grant; own request only.

fields.name: koineManagement
fields.description: koine:manage. Never returns bearer credentials.

fields.name: workspaceApplications
fields.description: Applications that the Spotlight index lists: one fixed query for application bundles over the Spotlight index with no search scope set, run once per call. Each choice has the path, display name and bundle identifier that the index reports, with source INDEXED_APPS. Copies of one identifier stay separate choices. Nothing is registered, resolved, launched or inspected, and the index can omit or lag applications, so a result is no inventory of the disk: category completeness is always UNKNOWN. An empty index answer is UNKNOWN with null items, never an empty inventory. A gathering that does not finish in three seconds, or one with more than 2048 items, is FAILED with null items and no prefix, and each selected items alias raises failed. Installation state, running state and bundle flags are not part of this release. All reachable fields require workspace:read.

fields.name: workspaceSpecialLocations
fields.description: Value-only Foundation lookup; null/omitted defaults to ten named pairs. Explicit nonempty unique requests <=10; HOME/Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Movies/Music/Pictures USER only; APPLICATIONS USER/LOCAL/SYSTEM. Never lists or inspects contents. All reachable fields require workspace:read.

types.name: Reference
types.description: Opaque koine:// URI string. Pass it unchanged; only its provider interprets the remainder.

types.name: String
types.description: The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

fields.name: applicationPath
fields.description: Absolute path of the bundle as the index reported it. It is not checked, resolved or opened, so it is not a bundle-directory identity and promises no installed or launchable application. Pass it with bundleIdentifier to workspaceLaunchApplication, which resolves it again.

fields.name: bundleIdentifier
fields.description: The bundle identifier that the index reports, or null when it reports none that Koine can pass on.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The localised display name that the index reports, or null when it reports none that Koine can pass on. Never taken from the path.

types.name: WorkspaceApplicationInput
types.description: A registered application bundle present at inspection, even if in the Trash. Requires a bundle identifier; bundle-less programs have no named-selector route. No executable, argv, environment or shell input.

inputFields.name: applicationPath
inputFields.description: Optional absolute path constraining selection to a registered bundle with this identifier, compared by native file identity after symlink resolution. Never substitute another copy when supplied; otherwise running-copy substitution is allowed.

inputFields.name: bundleIdentifier
inputFields.description: Nonblank native bundle identifier, not a display name or process identity.

types.name: WorkspaceDependencyReason
types.description: Pre-submission prerequisite failure; no successful value accompanies it.

types.name: WorkspaceDependencyUnavailable
types.description: A failed prerequisite, under workspace:control AND desktop:control. Not a stale issued reference or execution error.

fields.name: guidance
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Human explanation and recovery; never a shell command to execute automatically.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Closed reason for not submitting this action.

fields.name: category
fields.description: UNKNOWN for app/settings inventory and filesystem contents of starting values.

fields.name: observations
fields.description: Completeness of checked finite observations, not atomicity or internal health.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Only an independently identified location/pane; never parsed from error text.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Fixed target com.apple.systempreferences for Automation; established target or declared source otherwise.

types.name: WorkspaceDiscoveryStatus
types.description: Inspect sources, uncertainty and independent GraphQL errors together.

types.name: WorkspaceOpenReceipt
types.description: Native launch/open acknowledgment under workspace:control AND desktop:control, not proof of rendered content or foreground state. No installed path, bundle identifier or default-handler metadata is disclosed.

fields.name: process
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Optional observation of the completion callback's application: stable positive PID, matching kernel start reads and executable file identity, equal native application object, non-terminated at the checks. Any unavailable value or mismatch yields null. Not atomic effect binding; never a PID-only, launch-date or foreground fallback.

types.name: WorkspaceOpenResult
types.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control throughout. Absent an error at or below this result, AVAILABLE has value only and DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE has dependency only. A published status still describes the action when an error suppresses its branch; inspect data and error paths.

fields.name: dependency
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Non-null exactly for DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE absent an error at or below this result; this action submitted no domain request.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Selects the outcome; publication errors may suppress the selected branch or propagate through this result.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Non-null exactly for AVAILABLE absent an error at or below this result.

types.name: WorkspaceOperationStatus
types.description: AVAILABLE is native acknowledgment; DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE certifies this action submitted no domain request. Neither status overrides publication errors.

types.name: WorkspaceProcessIdentity
types.description: Observed process incarnation for this action, under workspace:control AND desktop:control. May exit immediately; not a desktop reference.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Positive process identifier; use only with startedAt.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Exact kernel process start instant, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ; copy with pid into the desktop process input under desktop:read.

types.name: WorkspaceRevealReceipt
types.description: Finder acknowledgment under workspace:control AND desktop:control; selection is not independently observed.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Submitted absolute path; a directory is selected in its parent, and root is shown as a root view.

types.name: WorkspaceRevealResult
types.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control throughout. Absent an error at or below this result, AVAILABLE has value only and DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE has dependency only. A published status still describes the action when an error suppresses its branch; inspect data and error paths.

fields.name: dependency
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Non-null exactly for DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE absent an error at or below this result; this action submitted no domain request.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Selects the outcome; publication errors may suppress the selected branch or propagate through this result.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Non-null exactly for AVAILABLE absent an error at or below this result.

fields.name: accountIdentifier
fields.description: UID of Koine's account, not the client's account.

fields.name: location
fields.description: OS-known absolute local value; no existence, access, listing or consent guarantee.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Frozen list for AVAILABLE/PARTIAL; otherwise null. FAILED raises failed at each selected items alias; BLOCKED/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN give ordinary null.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.

enumValues.name: QUERY
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a query operation.

enumValues.name: MUTATION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a mutation operation.

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a subscription operation.

enumValues.name: FIELD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an operation variable definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a union definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM_VALUE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum value definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object type definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object field definition.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the \`__TypeKind\` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional \`specifiedByURL\`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given \`__Type\` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. \`fields\` and \`interfaces\` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. \`fields\`, \`interfaces\`, and \`possibleTypes\` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. \`possibleTypes\` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. \`enumValues\` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. \`inputFields\` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. \`ofType\` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. \`ofType\` is a valid field.

directives.name: include
directives.description: Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the \`if\` argument is true.

directives.name: skip
directives.description: Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the \`if\` argument is true.

directives.name: deprecated
directives.description: Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

args.name: reason
args.description: Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted using the Markdown syntax, as specified by [CommonMark](https://commonmark.org/).

directives.name: specifiedBy
directives.description: Exposes a URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

directives.name: oneOf
directives.description: Indicates exactly one field must be supplied and this field must not be \`null\`.
